name: Sync Failure Alerts for Forminator & HubSpot
author: usekhar

sections.description:
Forminator can send form entries to HubSpot. When that hand-off fails, because a token expired, a field mapping broke, or HubSpot rejected the request, the enquiry stays in WordPress and nobody in the sales team sees it.

Sync Failure Alerts checks every new Forminator entry and emails you when:

  • Forminator reported that sending the entry to HubSpot failed (with the reported error, email addresses removed).
  • A form that normally sends to HubSpot saved an entry but no HubSpot result was recorded after a wait time you choose.
  • A HubSpot result exists but could not be read, so it is never silently counted as a success.

An optional daily report tells you how many enquiries were sent, failed or are missing a result, so you know the check is still running.

What it does not do

Honesty matters for a monitoring tool:

  • It reads the result Forminator recorded. It does not contact HubSpot itself, so a “sent” result is Forminator’s report, not an independent confirmation from HubSpot.
  • It cannot see enquiries that failed before Forminator saved them, HubSpot notification emails, or whether anyone followed up.
  • It does not re-send or repair entries.
  • A day with no entries is reported as “no entries”, because the plugin cannot tell a quiet day from a broken form.

Privacy

  • No data leaves your site except the alert emails you configure, sent through your site’s normal email.
  • The plugin stores only entry IDs, form IDs, states and short error text in its own table. It never copies form field values.
  • Uninstalling removes the plugin’s table and settings. Forminator’s data is never changed.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Forminator, with its HubSpot integration connected and entries saved.
  2. Install and activate Sync Failure Alerts.
  3. Go to Settings > Sync Failure Alerts, check the alert email address and click Send test email.
  4. Submit a test enquiry on your site, wait for the wait time, then click Run check now.

Only entries saved after activation are checked, so you are not flooded with old entries.
sections.faq:
How often does it check?

Every 15 minutes, using WordPress scheduled tasks. These only run when your site gets visits. On quiet sites, ask your host to call wp-cron.php from a real cron job. The settings page warns you if no check has run for 2 hours.

A form uses HubSpot but is never reported. Why?

Forms are monitored automatically once they have recorded at least one HubSpot result. If a form’s HubSpot connection never records anything at all, list its form ID under “Always monitor form IDs”.

What if my form is set not to store submissions?

Then there is nothing for Sync Failure Alerts to check. It only sees entries that Forminator saves in the WordPress database. Keep “store submissions” turned on for forms you want monitored.

Can I get an alert even though the contact did reach HubSpot?

Yes, occasionally. Sync Failure Alerts trusts what Forminator recorded. Some users have reported Forminator marking an entry as not sent while the contact did reach HubSpot. That is why alerts say an enquiry “may not have reached HubSpot”. Check the contact in HubSpot before contacting the person.

Are spam entries reported?

No. Entries Forminator marked as spam, with no HubSpot result, are counted as “marked as spam” and are not alerted. If a spam entry did record a HubSpot failure, it is still reported.

Does it work with other form plugins or CRMs?

Not yet. Version 0.1 supports Forminator’s HubSpot integration only.

short_description: Get an email when a Forminator entry fails to sync to HubSpot, plus a daily report, so no website lead is silently lost.
